story.title: Update the footer text on monthly statement PDFs
story.description: Update the monthly statement PDF footer text rendered by the document service to read: Thank you for banking with us. Apply the approved sentence to the English statement template and retain the existing font, alignment and page margins. The reporting service continues selecting the same template family and supplying the existing render payload. This is a presentation-only template update with fixed wording and a versioned layout asset. The existing rendering workflow remains unchanged. Publish a versioned template after preview approval; rollback consists of selecting the previous template version for subsequent statement rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Every page of newly rendered English monthly statement PDFs shows exactly: Thank you for banking with us.
Footer font, alignment, margins, page numbering and all other template content remain unchanged, including multi-page statements.
document-service and reporting-service use the existing render payload and template selection interfaces without modification.
An approved PDF preview confirms the footer fits the existing layout, and selecting the previous template version restores the prior footer.
